papers.headline: Map-Level Inference of Primordial Gravitational Waves from the CMB with Spherical Neural Networks
papers.summary: We train a spherical graph convolutional network to infer the tensor-to-scalar ratio r directly from multifrequency cosmic microwave background (CMB) B-mode maps on the cut sky.
papers.title: Map-Level Inference of Primordial Gravitational Waves from the CMB with Spherical Neural Networks

papers.headline: LEMUR: A Searchable Web Archive of Deep Chandra Images of Galaxies and Galaxy Clusters
papers.summary: We present LEMUR, a publicly accessible archive of uniformly reduced, deep Chandra images of 2,569 galaxies and galaxy clusters (including groups), comprising 5,505 ACIS observations and 138.8 Ms of exposure.
papers.title: LEMUR: A Searchable Web Archive of Deep Chandra Images of Galaxies and Galaxy Clusters

papers.headline: Discovery of a Massive Outer Companion to the TOI-178 Resonant Chain
papers.summary: We report the discovery of a massive outer companion around TOI-178, a known planetary system with six inner small planets within 0.15 AU, five of which are in a 2:4:6:9:12 resonant chain.
papers.title: Discovery of a Massive Outer Companion to the TOI-178 Resonant Chain
